editorial.description_en: A field after frost, before snow. Softer than wheat and further from yellow.
editorial.description_ja: 霜のあとの枯れた野のような、しずんだ黄土。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.746, C 0.054, h 80.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 枯れ (kare, withered) + 野 (no, field). It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Withered Field" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 枯野. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — hi-kabe at ΔE00 5.1, kari-ato at ΔE00 6.0, kare-wara at ΔE00 6.6. complementary is the entry nearest the opposite OKLCh hue (260°), within 22°. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
